name: define new cosets on demand and merge them whenever a relation forces a coincidence
mechanism: keep a table of how each generator moves each known coset; whenever tracing a relation needs an undefined entry, define a new coset; whenever tracing shows two coset names must be equal, merge them (and everything that follows from the merge); stop when every relation closes on every coset

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Todd–Coxeter algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Abstract algebra: Procedure for generating cosets.

requires: a finite index (otherwise it never stops)
fails_when: no bound on the intermediate table size; infinite index never terminates
